Half-Yearly Financial Report
& Results 2026

On July 24, 2026 the Volkswagen Group published the results for the first half of 2026.

Volkswagen Group stays on track in challenging environment and expects improved margin in the second half of the year

  • 158.1 billion EUR in sales revenue in H1 2026, at prior-year level (H1 2025: 158.4 billion EUR)
  • 5.9 billion EUR Operating Result in H1 2026, 11.6% below H1 2025 (6.7 billion EUR); operating return on sales of 3.8%
  • 6.9 billion EUR Operating Result before special items in H1 2026
  • 3.2 billion EUR Net Cash Flow in the Automotive Division in H1 2026 (H1 2025: -1.4 billion EUR)
  • 4.0 million vehicle sales in H1 2026, 8.4% below H1 2025 (4.4 million vehicles)
  • Order bank in Europe up by around 12% compared with year-end 2025
